overloads.semanticRole: The ACCEPT command is used in form or object methods (or in subroutines) to: accept a new or modified record, for which data entry has been initiated using ADD RECORD or MODIFY RECORD .

constraints: Cannot be queued: executing ACCEPT twice in a row in response to one event has the same effect as executing it once.
In headless mode, only allowed inside offscreen areas created by VP Run offscreen area or WA Run offscreen area.
